learn.hook: Fold a butterfly picture down the middle. Both halves match perfectly! That fold is a line of symmetry.
points: A line of symmetry cuts a shape into two halves that match exactly when folded.
Some shapes have one line of symmetry, some have many, and some have none.
A square has 4 lines of symmetry. A rectangle that is not a square has 2.
A triangle with all sides equal has 3 lines of symmetry. A circle has endless lines of symmetry.
Letters like A, T and V have a standing (vertical) line of symmetry. B, C and E have a lying (horizontal) one. F, L, N and S have none.

example.q: How many lines of symmetry does the letter H have?
steps: Fold H from top to bottom down the middle: the halves match.
Fold H from left to right across the middle: the halves match.

learn.reallife: Rangoli, the Taj Mahal from the front, leaves and many logos are symmetrical.

quiz.q: How many lines of symmetry does a square have?
quiz.explain: A square can be folded in half 4 ways: up-down, left-right and along both corner-to-corner lines.

quiz.q: How many lines of symmetry does a rectangle that is not a square have?
quiz.explain: It folds evenly only across the middle in two ways. A corner-to-corner fold does not make the halves match.
quiz.mistake: Thinks the diagonals of a rectangle are lines of symmetry, like in a square

quiz.q: Which letter has a line of symmetry?
quiz.explain: A folds down the middle into two matching halves. F, L and N do not match when folded.
quiz.mistake: Thinks any letter with straight lines is symmetrical

quiz.q: Which letter has NO line of symmetry?
quiz.explain: No fold makes the two halves of S match. H, T and E each have at least one line of symmetry.
quiz.mistake: Thinks S is symmetrical because it looks the same when turned upside down

quiz.q: A triangle has all 3 sides equal. How many lines of symmetry does it have?
quiz.explain: You can fold it from each corner to the middle of the opposite side. That is 3 lines.

quiz.q: Which letter has a lying (horizontal) line of symmetry, so its top half matches its bottom half?
quiz.explain: B folded from top to bottom matches. A, T and V have only a standing line of symmetry.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up standing (vertical) and lying (horizontal) lines

quiz.q: How many lines of symmetry does the capital letter H have?
quiz.explain: H matches when folded down the middle and when folded across the middle. That is 2 lines.
quiz.mistake: Finds only one of the two folds

quiz.q: Which of these has the most lines of symmetry?
quiz.explain: Any fold through the centre of a circle makes matching halves, so a circle has endless lines of symmetry.
quiz.mistake: Thinks the square has the most because it has 4

teach.ask: Gappu folded a paper heart down the middle and both halves matched! What is that fold line called?
teach.praise: Yes! When both halves match after folding, the fold is a line of symmetry. Gappu loves it!
teach.nudge: What happens to the two halves when Gappu folds? What do we call that line?

learn.hook: Put a mirror on half a picture and, like magic, the whole picture appears!
points: A mirror shows a flipped copy. Left becomes right and right becomes left.
If you know one half of a symmetrical shape, you can draw the other half like a mirror image.
Each point on one side is the same distance from the mirror line as its partner on the other side.
Fold paper, cut a shape on the fold and open it. You get a symmetrical shape!
In a mirror, b looks like d.

example.q: Half of a rangoli has 7 dots on the left of the fold line, and no dots on the line. How many dots are in the whole rangoli?
steps: The right half is a mirror copy of the left half.

learn.reallife: Mehendi designs, kite patterns and paper cut-outs for Diwali use mirror halves.

games.title: Mirror magic
items: In a mirror, your right hand looks like a left hand.
A mirror flips left and right.
The letter b looks like d in a mirror held to its side.
The bump flips to the other side.
The mirror half of a shape can be a different size.
Mirror halves are exactly the same size and shape.
If you cut a half-heart on a fold and open the paper, you get a whole heart.
The fold is the line of symmetry.
The word MOM looks the same in a mirror held to its side.
M and O look the same flipped, and the word reads the same both ways.
The letter F looks the same in a mirror held to its side.
F faces the other way in the mirror.

items.text: Left half has 5 petals and none are on the line. The whole flower has ___ petals.
A half-shape is 3 squares wide. The full shape is ___ squares wide.
In a mirror held to the side, the letter d looks like ___.
A dot is 2 squares to the left of the mirror line. Its mirror dot is 2 squares to the ___.

quiz.q: Riya folds a paper in half and cuts out half a heart along the fold. What does she get when she opens it?
quiz.explain: The fold is the line of symmetry. Opening it shows both matching halves joined: a whole heart.
quiz.mistake: Does not see that the fold joins the two halves

quiz.q: In a mirror held to its side, what does the letter b look like?
quiz.explain: A mirror flips left and right. The bump of b moves to the left side, making it look like d.
quiz.mistake: Flips it upside down instead of left to right

quiz.q: A symmetrical rangoli has 7 dots on the left of the fold line and none on the line. How many dots are in the whole rangoli?
quiz.explain: The right half is a mirror copy, so it has 7 dots too. 7 + 7 = 14.

quiz.q: Which word looks the same in a mirror held to its side?
quiz.explain: M and O look the same when flipped, and MOM reads the same both ways. B, D, S, N and P do not.
quiz.mistake: Checks only one letter of the word

quiz.q: Which digit looks the same in a mirror held to its side?
quiz.explain: 8 has a standing line of symmetry, so its mirror image is the same. 2, 4 and 7 face the other way.
quiz.mistake: Does not picture the digit flipped left to right

quiz.q: Arjun draws the left half of a symmetrical shape. It is 3 squares wide. How wide is the full shape?
quiz.explain: The right half is the same width as the left half. 3 + 3 = 6 squares.
quiz.mistake: Thinks the half is already the whole shape

quiz.q: A dot is 4 squares to the left of a mirror line. Where is its mirror dot?
options: 4 squares to the right of the line
4 squares to the left of the line
8 squares to the right of the line
quiz.explain: A mirror dot is the same distance from the line but on the other side.
quiz.mistake: Doubles the distance instead of keeping it the same

quiz.q: Kabir stands 2 steps in front of a mirror. How far behind the mirror does his image seem to be?
quiz.explain: Your mirror image always seems to be the same distance behind the mirror as you are in front of it.

teach.ask: Gappu has half a butterfly drawing and a mirror. How can Gappu see or draw the whole butterfly?
teach.praise: Magic! Put the mirror on the line and the other half appears, the same but flipped. Gappu's butterfly is complete!
teach.nudge: What does a mirror do to a picture? How is the other half related to the first half?
